set.body:
Outcome

Create the Phase 1 conformance court against public interfaces.

Acceptance

- Generators cover noncanonical IDs, reorders, selections, draws, invalid owners, weighted legs, and degenerate shapes.
- Dense and operator implementations obey identical semantic laws.
- Intentionally broken implementations demonstrate that the court detects identity loss and hidden reordering.
- Seeds and case budgets are reproducible on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P1.7: establish generated axis, reindexing, measurement, and backend laws
